text:
alex: Quick sync — planning Q2 roadmap for Console observability (dashboards, tracing, error analysis, retention). Need to pick GA vs beta scope. Customer-driven asks from FinRegCo and EduScale landed on my desk. Thoughts?
priya: +1. Let's list launch criteria first: 1) per-route latency and cost breakdown 2) trace correlation for multi-model requests 3) 30/90 day retention tiers available via UI and API 4) regression alerts on eval prompt sets. Anything else feels like stretch for GA.
jordan: From infra POV we need to cap cost exposure. Token-level traces are expensive. Suggest we ship sampled tracing for GA (1% by default) and full-trace for Dedicated customers.
sam: Token-level tracing isn't just cost — KV cache + streaming complicates reconstruction. Implementation effort estimate: 3 sprints to get reliable spans + UI plumbing.
maria: UX ask from early users: breadcrumbs for error analysis that link a trace -> exact prompt+response version. Otherwise support story becomes hard. We should include a compact 'inspect' panel in dashboards for GA.
nate: +customer note: FinRegCo requires 365d retention on audit logs (not full traces) and immutable export to S3. EduScale wants only 30d but with cheaper storage and automatic downsampling after 14d. Both are deal blockers.
priya: OK — split retention into two features: Audit-log retention (immutable, export) vs Telemetry retention (traces/metrics). Audit-log GA must support 365d export; telemetry can be tiered.
oj: ops-bot: Link to retention export design draft: https://redwood.internal/retention-export-draft (commented).
jordan: For dashboards, we need templated panels for common routes + an interactive trace heatmap. Backend work depends on the sampling strategy. If sampling is 1%, heatmap signals will be noisy for low-volume routes — need fallback aggregation.
alex: Proposal: GA scope = dashboards (templated + inspect panel), sampled tracing (1% default), audit-log export (365d), retention tiers 30/90 with downsampling job. Beta/ Dedicated features = full trace mode, per-token timeline view, and long-tail retention tier.
sam: Tech caveat: downsampling job to compress raw traces into sparse summaries will take an infra spike; recommend a pilot on a Dedicated cluster first.
maria: For product launch messaging we should call out "cost controls" and a developer toggle for sampling rate. Also add quickstart dashboard templates for SAML + FinRegCo templates.
priya: Draft OKR suggestion: Objective: Reduce MTTI for developers by 30% via Console observability. Key results: a) 3 templated dashboards shipped b) tracing sampling + inspect panel in GA c) Audit export GA with 365d support d) <10% cost uplift for hosted during GA.
nate: I'll surface FinRegCo compliance acceptance criteria verbatim: immutable export, access logs + KMS integration, and retention policy SLA.
alex: Decision call needed: Do we accept the 365d audit export as GA must-have? That drives storage + compliance work. My read: yes (enterprise deal), but we should gate non-enterprise customers from auto-enabling.
priya: Agree. Action items: - priya to write PRD for GA scope by Tue - sam + jordan to create tech spike tickets for token-trace plumbing - maria to design inspect panel mocks - nate to gather FinRegCo acceptance signoff - alex to draft rollout gating policy.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: created issue redwood/console-obsv#842 and linked spike tickets.
alex: Let's meet Wed 10am to finalize OKRs and resource commitments. If anyone needs to push back on scope, reply here by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
